---
title: "Download guide"
---

This page is for people who cannot use the HPC cluster or the SMB share
(see [Access](access.qmd)).

::: {.callout-warning}
HTTPS downloads are not available yet. The prefix
`{{< var https_prefix >}}` below is a placeholder.
:::

## 1. Make a URL list

In the [browser](browse.qmd), filter to the datasets you want, pick rows, open
**Get data → HTTPS download**, and click **Download urls.txt**. Lists are
capped at {{< var wget_max_files >}} files per request.

## 2. Download

With `wget`, keeping the directory layout:

```bash
wget --continue --force-directories --no-host-directories -i urls.txt
```

With `aria2c` (a few parallel connections; please keep it small):

```bash
aria2c --continue=true --max-concurrent-downloads=2 -i urls.txt
```

`--continue` resumes interrupted downloads, so you can rerun the same command.

## 3. Open the files

```python
import xarray as xr
ds = xr.open_mfdataset("cmip6/CMIP/NCAR/CESM2/historical/r1i1p1f1/Amon/tas/gn/v20190308/*.nc")
```

## Limits

- Downloads are rate limited per address. There is no directory listing:
  files are reachable only by exact URL.
- For more than a few hundred GB, use the cluster or ask about Globus via
  [Report a problem](report.qmd).
